_comment: Octail curated egg (plan §6.4), written for Octail on the pattern of the Paper egg (minecraft-paper.yaml): the universal jar from Sponge's download API v2 (dl-api.spongepowered.org) with its SHA-1 checked, latest meaning the newest recommended build, a Minecraft version without a recommended build getting its newest test build with a note, a version that does not exist fails the install, the eula flag (the panel asks the owner on the first start, nothing is pre-accepted), Java 25 to 8 images (newest first, as Paper), Minecraft Java idle sleep, install sandbox defaults and resource hints.
name: SpongeVanilla
author: octail@meowgafactory.com
description: SpongeVanilla runs Sponge plugins on the vanilla Minecraft server. Plugins go into mods/.

installation.script:
#!/bin/ash
# SpongeVanilla installation (Octail): the universal jar from Sponge's download API
# (dl-api.spongepowered.org, v2), its SHA-1 checked. "latest" is the newest recommended build; a
# Minecraft version picks that version's newest recommended build (or its newest test build when it
# has no recommended one yet). A version or build that doesn't exist fails the install.
#
# Server files: /mnt/server
set -eu

API=https://dl-api.spongepowered.org/v2/groups/org.spongepowered/artifacts/spongevanilla
JAR="${SERVER_JARFILE:-spongevanilla.jar}"
VERSION="${MINECRAFT_VERSION:-latest}"
ARTIFACT="${SPONGE_VERSION:-latest}"

fail() {
	echo "Install failed: $*"
	exit 1
}
get() { curl -fsSL --retry 3 --connect-timeout 20 "$1"; }
first() { jq -r '.artifacts | keys_unsorted[0] // empty'; }

mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

if [ -z "${ARTIFACT}" ] || [ "${ARTIFACT}" = "latest" ]; then
	if [ -z "${VERSION}" ] || [ "${VERSION}" = "latest" ]; then
		ARTIFACT=$(get "${API}/versions?recommended=true&limit=1" | first) || fail "can't reach Sponge's download API"
		[ -n "${ARTIFACT}" ] || fail "Sponge's download API lists no recommended SpongeVanilla build"
	else
		case "${VERSION}" in
		*[!0-9A-Za-z.-]*) fail "the Minecraft version (${VERSION}) can only hold letters, digits, dots and dashes" ;;
		esac
		ARTIFACT=$(get "${API}/versions?tags=minecraft:${VERSION}&recommended=true&limit=1" | first) ||
			fail "can't reach Sponge's download API"
		if [ -z "${ARTIFACT}" ]; then
			ARTIFACT=$(get "${API}/versions?tags=minecraft:${VERSION}&limit=1" | first) || ARTIFACT=""
			[ -n "${ARTIFACT}" ] || fail "SpongeVanilla has no build for Minecraft ${VERSION}. See https://spongepowered.org/downloads/spongevanilla"
			echo "Note: Minecraft ${VERSION} has no recommended SpongeVanilla build yet; using the test build ${ARTIFACT}."
		fi
	fi
fi
case "${ARTIFACT}" in
*[!0-9A-Za-z.-]*) fail "the SpongeVanilla version (${ARTIFACT}) can only hold letters, digits, dots and dashes" ;;
esac

INFO=$(get "${API}/versions/${ARTIFACT}") || fail "SpongeVanilla has no build ${ARTIFACT}"
# The universal jar runs the server (Sponge API 8 and newer); older builds ship one plain jar.
ASSET=$(echo "${INFO}" | jq -c '[.assets[] | select(.extension == "jar" and .classifier == "universal")] + [.assets[] | select(.extension == "jar" and .classifier == "")] | .[0] // empty')
[ -n "${ASSET}" ] || fail "SpongeVanilla ${ARTIFACT} has no server jar"
URL=$(echo "${ASSET}" | jq -r '.downloadUrl // empty')
SHA1=$(echo "${ASSET}" | jq -r '.sha1 // empty' | tr 'A-F' 'a-f')
MC=$(echo "${INFO}" | jq -r '.tags.minecraft // empty')
RECOMMENDED=$(echo "${INFO}" | jq -r '.recommended // false')
case "${URL}" in
https://repo.spongepowered.org/*) ;;
*) fail "Sponge's download API gave an unexpected download address for ${ARTIFACT}" ;;
esac
echo "${SHA1}" | grep -Eq '^[0-9a-f]{40}$' || fail "Sponge's download API gave no SHA-1 for ${ARTIFACT}"
if [ "${RECOMMENDED}" != "true" ]; then
	echo "Note: SpongeVanilla ${ARTIFACT} is not a recommended build."
fi

echo "Installing SpongeVanilla ${ARTIFACT} (Minecraft ${MC}) as ${JAR}"
rm -f "${JAR}.download"
curl -fsSL --retry 3 --connect-timeout 20 -o "${JAR}.download" "${URL}" ||
	fail "the download of SpongeVanilla ${ARTIFACT} failed"
GOT=$(sha1sum "${JAR}.download" | cut -d ' ' -f 1)
if [ "${GOT}" != "${SHA1}" ]; then
	rm -f "${JAR}.download"
	fail "SHA-1 mismatch for SpongeVanilla ${ARTIFACT} (expected ${SHA1}, got ${GOT})"
fi
if [ -f "${JAR}" ]; then
	mv -f "${JAR}" "${JAR}.old"
fi
mv "${JAR}.download" "${JAR}"

echo "SpongeVanilla ${ARTIFACT} installed (SHA-1 checked). Sponge plugins go into mods/."
echo "Accepting the Minecraft EULA (https://aka.ms/MinecraftEULA) is the server owner's decision: the panel asks on the first start."

variables.name: Minecraft Version
variables.description:
The Minecraft version, such as 1.21.10, or latest for the newest recommended SpongeVanilla build. A version without a recommended build gets its newest test build; one without any build fails the install.

The Startup image must fit it: Java 21 for 1.20.5 to 1.21.x (Java 25 for 26.x), Java 17 for 1.17 to 1.20.4, Java 8 for 1.12.2 and 1.16.5.

variables.name: Server Jar File
variables.description: The name of the server jar file.

variables.name: SpongeVanilla Version
variables.description: A full SpongeVanilla version such as 1.21.10-17.0.0 (Minecraft version, then Sponge API version), or latest to pick one from the Minecraft version.
